newsitem.title: USA: Tellabs to supply TITAN to Cincinnati Bell.
newsitem.headline: Tellabs to supply TITAN to Cincinnati Bell.

text.p: Tellabs Inc said Monday it signed a letter of intent to supply its TITAN 5500 digital cross-connect system to Cincinnati Bell Telephone.
The system is based on Synchronous Optical Network (SONET), a set of telecommunications for fiber optic transmission.
Tellabs said the two companies are completing a contract naming Tellabs as Cincinnati Bell's sole source for SONET 3/1 digital cross-connect systems.
Tellab said the digital cross-connect system and its TITAN 5500 will improve service, reduce operating costs and position the network for future upgrades.
